$comment: Canonical guarded-command policy. Rendered into per-agent hook configs and AGENTS.md by pnpm ai:install. `command` matches leading normalized command tokens; `flag` matches an option token, excluding supported argument values and tokens after --. Supported literal syntax and limitations are documented in docs/agents/agent-engineering.md. `deny` blocks matched calls on agents that honour the hook; `ask` is a three-state verdict on Claude, Cursor, and OpenCode (OpenCode: rules without a flag) and degrades to an advisory elsewhere.

rules.reason: Unrestricted schema push can drop columns in DATABASE_URL. Shared and deployed databases require pnpm db:generate and reviewed migrations. The local wrapper requires explicit opt-in and validates loopback PostgreSQL.

Bypasses commitlint, the AI-attribution gate, and the pre-push typecheck. Fix the hook failure instead of skipping it.
Rewrites the seed user's credential row in whatever DATABASE_URL points at.
